jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship at the Danish Institute for International Studies
jobs.description:
PhD scholarship at the Danish Institute for International Studies, Military Artificial Intelligence, Peace and International Security

The Danish Institute for International Studies (DIIS) is recruiting a PhD candidate to research military applications of artificial intelligence and their implications for peace and international security. We are especially interested in projects that examine how the development and use of AI-based military capabilities affect established practices of decision-making, human control, and accountability. The project should connect a nuanced understanding of the dynamics of technological change to wider questions of arms control and international regulation. 

The position is based at the DIIS Centre for Peace Research and will thematically be placed under one of the three pillars of the Centre, namely Arms control in a time of arms races and war. One of the questions that the Centre focuses on is how Nordic countries, including Denmark, can navigate a situation where the development of new technologies (e.g. AI and drones), along with increasing great power rivalry and competition in space, entail new types of security risks that traditional arms control models and treaties do not effectively regulate.

The successful candidate will develop an independent PhD project that speaks to the overall focus of the center and produces research relevant to Nordic and international debates on security and peace.

About the position AI is changing how military organizations collect information, assess threats, select targets and coordinate operations. These capabilities are currently developed faster than military doctrine, legal interpretation and oversight arrangements intended to govern their use. This raises questions about who exercises control, how responsibility is assigned, and how other states interpret capabilities whose operation is difficult to observe. Within this overall frame relevant proposals may examine:

• 
The relationship between the adoption of AI and the development of military doctrine

• 
The effects of AI-enabled decision support on military decision-making and the human role therein

• 
The impact of uncertainty and opacity around the current state of AI integration among militaries on escalation dynamics and arms-race dynamics

• 
Regulation of AI through multilateral governance mechanisms in and beyond the UN

• 
Human judgement and accountability in military applications of AI

About DIIS and the positionThe successful candidate will be employed by DIIS in a three-year, full-time PhD position, expected to commence on 1 February 2027. The candidate will be enrolled in the PhD School at the Faculty of Social Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), while their primary place of work will be the Centre for Peace Research at DIIS.

The PhD project will be jointly supervised by a senior researcher at DIIS and Professor Ingvild Bode at SDU.

At DIIS, the PhD candidate will join an inspiring and ambitious research environment committed to advancing multidisciplinary scholarship. The successful candidate is expected to engage actively in cross-disciplinary collaboration and to value insights from colleagues working with different theoretical and methodological approaches. Such exchanges across disciplinary boundaries are central to the research environment at DIIS.

We expect the candidate to:

• 
have obtained a master’s degree in a relevant field

• 
have at least received the grade of 10 (or equivalent) for the master’s thesis according to the Danish 7-point grading scale and a high weighted grade point average 

• 
meet the general requirements for being accepted for enrolment as a PhD candidate (see below)

• 
live up to the DIIS entry criteria for PhD positions https://www.diis.dk/files/media/document/diis-entry-criteria-rev-okt-24.pdf 

• 
communicate clearly in written and spoken English, and proficiency in Danish is an advantage.

DIIS as a workplaceWe offer an attractive and inclusive workplace where our employees can develop. We consider knowledge sharing and feedback essential to creating a dynamic workplace. We expect you to participate proactively in the common efforts of the institute. We prioritize a high degree of presence but want our employees to have a good work-life balance. Therefore, we offer flexible working hours and some possibility of working from home. We are located very close to Copenhagen’s city center with excellent public transportation options.

DIIS is a diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified candidates to apply for this position regardless of their personal background. DIIS is also a workplace where we consider the environmental consequences of our activities and strive to adopt more environmentally sustainable practices both in relation to our daily business at DIIS and our global travel activities.

In the assessment, consideration will be given to the following criteria:

• 
The applicant has a relevant master’s degree or equivalent qualifications (corresponding to the 3 + 2 Bologna process), cf. the Danish qualifications framework for higher education

• 
Quality and relevance of the project description

• 
Quality and relevance of the methodical and theoretical choices

• 
Consistency and coherence between the research problem and the choice of method and theory

• 
The realistic and feasible scope of the PhD project

• 
Relevance of the project for the DIIS Centre for Peace Research and DIIS in general

Contract and remunerationThe position as PhD candidate starts on 1 February 2027 and is a 3-year full-time position. Remuneration and other job conditions follow the general agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC) and the Danish Ministry of Finance, local collective agreements at DIIS as well as the 28 June 2019 Danish state protocol on PhD candidates. 

The standard starting salary for a PhD candidate at DIIS is 379,702,61 DKK per year excl. pensions – this may be increased depending on prior work experience after the acquisition of the master’s degree. A pension contribution of 18,07% is added to the above-mentioned salary.

Do you want to know more?Visit http://www.diis.dk/jobs to learn more about DIIS as a workplace. Questions regarding employment and renumeration can be sent to hr@diis.dk. If you have inquiries regarding the professional focus of the position, you can contact Senior Researcher and Head of Research Unit, Mona Kanwal Sheikh at mosh@diis.dk  

The applicationDeadline for applying is 23 October 2026, at 12.00 pm CET. 

Please note that we only accept applications through DIIS’ electronic recruitment system. 

Your application must include all the following documents:

• 
A motivational letter

• 
Curriculum Vitae 

• 
Master’s diploma including grades. If you hold a master’s degree which is not within the ECTS-framework, please also provide:

• 
Your bachelor diploma and bachelor grades

• 
A statement clarifying the subject and length (in years) of the master’s degree

• 
An English translation of your diplomas 

• 
PhD project proposal (max 5 pages)

• 
Publication list

DIIS is an independent public research institution for international studies. We conduct and communicate multidisciplinary research on globalisation, security, development and foreign policy and within these areas we aim to be agenda-setting in research, policy and public debate.

DIIS participates in academic networks and publish in high-ranking academic journals, always striving to excel in academic scholarship.

We continuously assess Denmark's foreign and political situation and inform the Danish media, politicians and the public about our work

jobs.occupation: Software Tester & Quality Specialist – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition
jobs.description:
Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. 

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet. 

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.  

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system. 

Right now, we are looking for a Software Tester & Quality Specialist who likes to make a difference! 

Job description: 

As a Software Tester & Quality Specialist in the Quality Management team, you will work closely with developers, business experts, product owners, project managers, test managers, and fellow testers to help ensure the quality of Nordic RCC's systems and services.

We believe quality starts long before testing begins. Therefore, you will be involved early in the development process, helping teams identify risks, clarify requirements, and prepare testing activities before solutions are implemented. We are in the progress of strengthening our processes and “shifting-left” to achieve this target state.

You will contribute throughout the development lifecycle by reviewing acceptance criteria, creating test data, designing and executing tests, supporting business and operators is test decision and execution, and communicating test results and quality concerns. By working closely with both business and development teams, you will help ensure that quality is built into our solutions from the start.

Your key responsibilities are:

• 
Work closely with developers, business experts, product owners, project managers, test managers, and fellow testers throughout the development lifecycle.

• 
Participate in requirement reviews, refinement sessions, and solution discussions to identify risks, gaps, and testing needs as early as possible.

• 
Help ensure that testing considerations are included early in development activities and that quality is addressed before implementation is completed.

• 
Review requirements, user stories, and solution designs to identify potential risks, gaps, and ambiguities.

• 
Identify dependencies, prerequisites, and test data requirements for testing activities.

• 
Create, maintain, and analyse test data to support testing across different systems and environments.

• 
Design, maintain, and execute test cases and test scenarios based on business and technical requirements.

• 
Perform manual and exploratory testing to verify functionality, usability, integrations, and business processes.

• 
Identify, document, and follow up on defects and quality issues in collaboration with development teams and business stakeholders.

• 
Support investigation and root cause analysis of defects and recurring quality issues.

• 
Contribute test cases, effort estimates, dependencies, and risks as input to test planning activities.

• 
Document and communicate test results, findings, and quality concerns to support project and test management reporting.

• 
Collaborate with developers and test automation specialists to improve testing practices and automated quality controls.

• 
Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing methods, test data practices, and quality assurance processes across Nordic RCC.

Proactive position with outstanding attention to detail and excellent communication skills 

On the personal level you have attention to details, good communication and collaboration skills, analytical thinking and problem solving. You are a self-driven and proactive person, responsible, structured and have a strong focus on finding a solution to the problems at hand.

The ideal candidate is expected to have a minimum of 5 years in manual test experience, an education at BA or MA level in computer science or engineering, but experience from a similar role is more important.

Technical skills: 

• 
Collaborate with internal and external development teams in the CI/CD process. 

• 
Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, etc), tools, processes, and development cycles (SDLC). 

• 
Experience with test data creation

• 
Good understanding of test automation

Preferred Qualifications: 

• 
ISTQB certification or equivalent 

• 
Experience with test management tools - Azure DevOps, Jira, etc. 

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

Employment conditions 

You will join a team of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 22 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

Note: The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 1st November 2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system. 

If you have any questions, please contact Håkon Rosenaa Nystad, Manager, Quality Management, hny@nordic-rcc.net.

jobs.occupation: QA/RA Engineer – Medical Devices (MDR)
jobs.description:
Copenhagen area, Denmark (Industrivej 12, 3540 Lynge). Hybrid: remote work with on-site visits to Valcon typically once or twice a month. Candidates based elsewhere in the EU are welcome to apply. Application deadline: 30 October 2026. We are hiring as soon as possible, so applications are reviewed as received and the posting may close earlier once the position is filled.

Do you have solid experience with quality assurance and regulatory affairs for medical devices under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and are you motivated by the opportunity to build a QA/RA function from the ground up?

Would you like to take ownership of technical documentation, risk management, and Notified Body compliance for a growing medical device portfolio?

Then you might be our new QA/RA Engineer.

About Valcon Medical

Valcon Medical A/S manufactures medical cannabis extracts and cannabis oils for the Danish market and a number of export markets. We are approved by the Danish Medicines Agency to manufacture medical cannabis in accordance with EU-GMP and applicable Danish legislation on medical cannabis.

We are a company in development, with new products, processes, and technologies entering the organization, including an expanding medical device portfolio. This role is being established to build our QA/RA function for compliance with EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016, and to ensure our device documentation and processes meet Notified Body and Competent Authority expectations.

You will work closely with colleagues across Quality, R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs. As a smaller company, we have short decision-making paths, and the QA/RA function works closely with the rest of the organization. You will therefore have the opportunity to work with both classic QA/RA tasks and take responsibility for new issues, where you will independently investigate, assess, and help find the right solution, including shaping how our MDR compliance function is built from an early stage.

Areas of responsibility for the QA/RA function

• 
Implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System in compliance with ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745

• 
Maintain current knowledge of EU MDR 2017/745, ISO 13485:2016, and relevant harmonised standards, and advise the organization on compliance matters

• 
Preparation and maintenance of Technical Documentation (MDR Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist (Annex I) traceability to design and verification/validation evidence

• 
Document Control as a core, ongoing function: creation, revision, review/approval routing, distribution, and archival of controlled documents and records (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.2.4/4.2.5)

• 
Change Control: assessment and impact evaluation across design, risk, and regulatory documentation, and approval routing for design, process, and document changes

• 
Risk management (ISO 14971) throughout the product lifecycle, including FMEA documentation and risk control/mitigation measures

• 
Review and approval of verification and validation protocols and reports, and support for validation of processes, software, and equipment (e.g. IEC 62304, as applicable to the product)

• 
Preparation and review of CAPAs and nonconformance reports

• 
Supplier qualification and ongoing oversight of critical suppliers, including Quality Assurance Agreements (ISO 13485:2016 Clauses 4.1.5 and 7.4)

• 
Conduct supplier audits and support Notified Body audits under the MDR Annex IX conformity assessment procedure

• 
Post-Market Surveillance per MDR Articles 83–86, including complaint handling, PMS reporting, and PMCF as applicable

• 
Vigilance reporting to Competent Authorities per MDR Articles 87–92, including serious incident reporting and Field Safety Corrective Actions

• 
UDI assignment and EUDAMED registration activities (Basic UDI-DI, UDI-DI, device and certificate registration)

• 
Clinical Evaluation Report maintenance per MDR Article 61 / Annex XIV, in coordination with Clinical Affairs, where applicable

• 
Collaborate with R&D, Manufacturing, and Clinical Affairs to embed GSPR (Annex I) and Design Control (ISO 13485:2016 Clause 7.3) requirements into product development and production

• 
Provide training to employees on QMS requirements, EU MDR obligations, and risk-management practices

• 
Provide input on EU regulatory submissions and CE-marking compliance strategy, including engagement with Notified Bodies

Your qualifications and experience

We envision that you have:

• 
A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related field

• 
A minimum of 2–5 years of experience in QA/RA roles within the medical device industry, working under EU MDR 2017/745 and ISO 13485:2016

• 
Hands-on working experience inside a live, certified ISO 13485:2016 Quality Management System, not solely academic or classroom knowledge of the standard

• 
Direct, hands-on experience operating within core QMS processes: Supplier Control, Document Control, Change Control, Complaint Handling, and CAPA

• 
Working knowledge of ISO 13485:2016 and EU MDR 2017/745, and of relevant harmonised standards (e.g. ISO 14971, IEC 62366-1, IEC 60601 series, IEC 62304 as applicable to the product)

• 
Demonstrated, hands-on authorship or maintenance experience with EU MDR Technical Documentation (Annex II/III), including GSPR checklist mapping and design/verification/validation evidence linkage. General familiarity with the standard is not sufficient

• 
Ability to interpret and apply EU regulatory requirements effectively, including direct engagement with Notified Bodies

• 
Fluent English, written and spoken, for Notified Body and international supplier communication

It is an advantage, but not a requirement, to have experience with one or more of the following areas:

• 
EUDAMED, the UDI system, and Basic UDI-DI concepts

• 
EU GMP requirements, given Valcon's GMP-regulated production environment

• 
Danish language skills

Your competencies

• 
Works in a structured and systematic manner, with a focus on completing tasks

• 
Able to work independently, take responsibility for own tasks, and drive projects forward

• 
Strong grasp of risk management (ISO 14971) and verification/validation principles

• 
Enjoys a mix of technical assessment, practical problem-solving, and documentation work

• 
Is proactive, solution-oriented, and contributes positively to collaboration with colleagues

• 
Competencies in data processing and report writing

What we offer

You will have a broad and independent role in a company in development, where you will help build our medical device QA/RA function from an early stage and work closely with production, product development, and the company's other activities.

As part of a smaller organization, you will have short decision-making paths, extensive insight across the company, and the opportunity to have real influence on both your own areas of responsibility and the development of our QA/RA function.

For the right person, there are good opportunities to develop the role as the company grows and to take responsibility for new subject areas and projects.

This is a hybrid role. Most of the work can be done remotely, and we expect you on site at our facility in Lynge, north of Copenhagen, typically once or twice a month. Expect more frequent presence during onboarding and around Notified Body and supplier audits. [Travel costs to Valcon are covered by the company.]

How to apply

The position is based in our QA/RA function. If you would like to hear more about the job, please contact Chanel La (cl@valcon-medical.com) 

Please send your CV to job@valcon-medical.com. In your application, please include 3–4 sentences on a Technical Documentation or CAPA process you personally owned under a certified ISO 13485 QMS: what you did and what the outcome was.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Packing & Fulfilment Coordinator
jobs.description:
Packing & Fulfilment Coordinator — MK STUDIO, Glostrup

Hourly paid · 150 DKK/hour · Minimum 32 h/week guaranteed, Mon–Fri · Up to 40 h/week in busy periods · Start October–November 2026

MK STUDIO (mk-ceramics ApS) makes handmade porcelain cups, plates, bowls and coffee drippers in Glostrup. We're a team of seven across the workshop, office and our Copenhagen shop, selling to cafés, roasters and coffee people across Denmark, the EU and Asia.

In a strong week we make 500–1000 cups. We're looking for the person who gets every order out the door correctly and makes sure nothing leaves the studio with a defect.

What you'll do

Orders and customers (about half your week)

• 
Pack 10–15 webshop orders a day, plus wholesale (B2B) orders

• 
Book shipments and print labels in the DHL and UPS apps

• 
Prepare invoices, packing lists and customs documents for shipments outside the EU

• 
Answer all order and customer emails: order status, delays, returns, breakage claims

• 
Handle claims with carriers for damaged or lost parcels

• 
Keep packing materials in stock

Studio and stock (about half your week)

• 
Unload kilns after the glaze firing

• 
Check every piece and sort it: first quality, seconds, reject

• 
Finishing work on fired pieces

• 
Organise the stock room and keep stock numbers correct in our order system

You're the last check before a piece reaches a customer.

What you need

• 
Fluent written and spoken English — you'll talk and write to customers every day

• 
Right to work in Denmark

• 
You can lift and carry up to 20 kg (kiln shelves, boxes) and work on your feet most of the day in a studio with clay dust

• 
Available Monday to Friday, at least 32 hours a week, with extra hours in busy periods, from October–November 2026

• 
Experience with order handling, shipping, warehouse, e-commerce, customer service or similar work

• 
You plan your own day, handle several tasks at once, and flag mistakes early

Good to have

• 
Danish

• 
Driving licence

• 
DHL/UPS bookings and claims

• 
Customs or export paperwork

• 
Experience packing fragile goods (glass, ceramics, wine)

• 
e-conomic, Shopify or spreadsheets

• 
Ceramics or quality-control experience

What we offer

• 
150 DKK/hour, plus holiday pay

• 
32 guaranteed hours a week

• 
3-month trial period

• 
After 6 months, we sit down and negotiate your pay based on your performance and any extra tasks you've taken on

• 
A small team with short lines and fast decisions

• 
Full training in our systems and quality standards

How to apply

Apply through the form at www.mk-ceramics.com/pages/mk-studio-work-with-us (select "Packing").

Write a short message telling us why you'd like to work with us and why you think you're a good fit for this job. Then answer these five questions with yes or no, based on this job ad:

• 
Is this job paid by the hour?

• 
Is the guaranteed minimum 40 hours a week?

• 
Is about half of the job packing orders and answering customer emails?

• 
Do you need to work weekends in this job?

• 
Does the job start in January 2027?

We'll reply by email and ask for your CV.

jobs.occupation: Teamlead Reliability Engineers (m/w/d) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description: Operations and techniciansTeamlead Reliability EngineersImagine a future where you lead an international engineering team that improves the safety, reliability, and performance of our wind farms.Join us in this role where you’ll provide people and technical leadership to the Continental Europe Reliability Engineering team. You’ll set priorities, develop capabilities, and enable consistent, high-quality reliability support across our wind farms. Through data-driven decisions and close collaboration, you’ll help address technical risks, improve asset performance, and strengthen the way we work across sites and turbine platforms. Welcome to Generation CE You’ll be part of WTG Engineering where you, together with your colleagues, will support our operational sites by identifying and addressing technical risks, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, and improvement opportunities. You’ll connect Reliability Engineers, site teams, CE Engineering, Technical Support, and other specialist functions to coordinate effective corrective and preventive actions. As a team, we share knowledge, support one another, and turn technical insight into practical improvements. We succeed as one by building trust across sites, giving our experts the context and space to make decisions, and keeping safety at the heart of our work. You’ll play an important role in: leading, motivating, and developing an international team of Reliability Engineers through clear objectives, coaching, competence planning, and development conversations translating Generation, CE Engineering, and site priorities into an aligned reliability engineering plan with clear ownership, milestones, and outcomes ensuring structured analysis of reliability performance, yield-loss drivers, recurring failures, technical risks, and emerging trends overseeing root-cause analyses, technical assessments, corrective and preventive actions, and prioritised reliability improvement initiatives strengthening consistent reliability practices, knowledge sharing, and collaboration across operational sites, engineering functions, suppliers, and technical support teams promoting a proactive safety culture and ensuring compliance with asset integrity, HSE, governance, and applicable technical requirements. To succeed in the role, you: have a relevant technical or engineering qualification within mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, reliability, asset management, wind energy, or a comparable field, or equivalent experience bring leadership experience that enables you to develop people, set priorities, allocate resources, and create clarity across an international or multi-site team understand wind turbine operations, reliability engineering, technical support, maintenance engineering, asset integrity, or another high-reliability industry have strong knowledge of reliability and continuous-improvement methods, such as root-cause analysis, trend analysis, failure-mode analysis, reliability-centred maintenance, risk assessment, and corrective-action management can interpret technical and operational performance data and turn your findings into clear priorities, decisions, and measurable improvement actions communicate complex technical matters clearly, build trusted stakeholder relationships, and work professionally in English. Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. Shape the future with us Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate. As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com (accommodation@orsted.com) . Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position. Position salary range: For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.Pre-employment background checks:For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

jobs.occupation: Kitchen Manager, Diamond Slice
jobs.description:
Dansk Version - English below

Kitchen Manager – Diamond Slice

Lokation: København (Blågårds Plads / Tagensvej)Ansættelsesform: Fuldtid / Deltid (Aftener og weekender)Løn: 175 – 185 kr./time (baseret på erfaring)Tiltrædelse: Hurtigst muligt

Om Diamond Slice

Diamond Slice serverer New York-style surdejspizza slices i København fra vores afdelinger på Blågårds Plads og Tagensvej. Vi kombinerer klassiske amerikanske slice-opskrifter med gode råvarer, koldhævet dej og bagning ved høj varme. Vi har fart på både i restauranterne og på takeaway, og vi er en virksomhed i fortsat vækst.

Rollen

Som Kitchen Manager er du ansvarlig for den daglige drift i køkkenet. Det er din opgave at sikre et højt bundniveau på alle serveringer, holde styr på systemer og hygiejne, samt lede køkkenholdet i tæt samarbejde med vores front of house (FOH).

Primære ansvarsområder

• 
Daglig køkkendrift, herunder prep, bagning og løbende kvalitetskontrol

• 
Varebestillinger, varemodtagelse og lagerstyring

• 
Oplæring, instruktion og daglig ledelse af køkkenpersonalet

• 
Overholdelse af hygiejnestandarder, rengøringsrutiner og egenkontrol

• 
Daglig koordinering og kontakt med FOH under service

• 
Sikring af et højt arbejdstempo under spidsbelastninger og takeaway-ryk

Krav og profil

• 
Minimum 3 års erfaring fra restaurationsbranchen

• 
Erfaring med pizzabagning ELLER erfaring med ledelse er et krav (erfaring med ledelse af et pizzakøkken er en klar fordel)

• 
Tryg ved at arbejde selvstændigt uden direkte supervision og med stærke beslutningsevner

• 
Meget velstruktureret og organiseret, og motiveres af at arbejde hurtigt og slå uret under travle perioder

God fysisk form og komfortabel med hele vagter på benene

• 
Klar og parat til at arbejde aften- og weekendvagter

• 
Gode engelskkundskaber (dansk er en kærkommen bonus)

Vi tilbyder

• 
Timeløn på 175 – 185 kr./time baseret på erfaring

Grundig oplæring og faglige færdigheder i at producere New York-style pizza i særklasse

• 
En arbejdsom, men venlig og støttende arbejdskultur

• 
En virksomhed i vækst med reel mulighed for mere ansvar og stigende løn over tid

• 
En fleksibel vagtplan

Sådan ansøger du

Send dit CV samt en kort motiveret ansøgning til:Email: work@diamondslice.dkEmnefelt: Kitchen ManagerAnsøgninger gennemgås løbende.

English Version

Kitchen Manager – Diamond Slice

Location: Copenhagen (Blågårds Plads / Tagensvej)Employment Type: Full-time / Part-time (Evenings and weekends)Pay: 175 – 185 DKK / hour (based on experience)Start Date: As soon as possible

About Diamond Slice

Diamond Slice serves New York-style sourdough pizza by the slice in Copenhagen from our locations at Blågårds Plads and Tagensvej. We combine traditional American slice shop recipes with quality ingredients, cold-fermented dough, and high-heat deck ovens. We run busy counter, dine-in, and delivery services, and we are actively building for future growth.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Daily kitchen operations, including prep, baking, and ongoing quality control

• 
Ordering goods, receiving deliveries, and inventory management

• 
Directing, training, and supervising kitchen staff on shift

• 
Maintaining strict kitchen cleanliness, hygiene routines, and Danish food safety standards

• 
Serving as the main kitchen contact point for FOH during service

• 
Managing rush periods and high-volume delivery tickets calmly and efficiently

Requirements

• 
Minimum 3 years of experience in the hospitality industry

• 
Experience with pizza OR experience with management is required (experience managing a pizza kitchen is a strong advantage)

• 
Confident working solo without direct supervision, with strong decision-making skills

• 
Highly structured, organized, and genuinely energized by working fast and beating the clock during rush hours

• 
Comfortable working full shifts on your feet

• 
Ready and available to work evening and weekend shifts

• 
Strong communication skills in English (Danish is an appreciated bonus)

What We Offer

•

jobs.occupation: Erfaren Kok / Kitchen Lead – Rays Chicken på Gamma Bar (Nordvest)

Dansk Version - English version below

Lokation: Gamma Bar, Nordvest, København

Ansættelsesform: Deltid / Fuldtid (Aftener og weekender)

Løn: 165 – 185 kr./time (baseret på erfaring)

Om Rays Chicken

Hos Rays Chicken tager vi fried chicken seriøst. Vi laver ekstra sprød, kærnemælksmarineret fried chicken krydret med vores egen hemmelige krydderiblanding, som vi serverer for et livligt og fyldt Gamma Bar i København Nordvest.

Vi lægger i øjeblikket fundamentet for spændende fremtidig vækst og søger en dedikeret kok, der har lyst til at være en central del af den rejse.

Rollen

Vi søger en erfaren og pålidelig køkkenprofil, der kan tage ansvar for den daglige køkkendrift, opretholde en høj madkvalitet og bevare overblikket under travle perioder.

På de mere rolige vagter i starten af ugen har du fuld frihed og selvstændighed til at preppe og køre køkkenet alene. På de travle aftener styrer du servicen og leder køkkenets medhjælpere og opvaskere.

Vigtigste ansvarsområder:

• 
Mise en place og service: Daglig klargøring, madlavning, fritering, anretning og sikring af en høj standard.

• 
Selvstændige vagter: Ansvar for at drive køkkendriften solo på ugens tidlige vagter.

• 
Teamledelse: Vagtplanlægning, instruktion og supervision af køkkenmedhjælpere og opvaskere.

• 
Lager og indkøb: Styring af varebeholdning, varebestillinger, varemodtagelse samt daglig kontakt med leverandører.

• 
Hygiejne og fødevaresikkerhed: Holde orden i køkkenets systemer og strengt overholde danske standarder for fødevarehygiejne og egenkontrol.

• 
Digitale bestillinger: Effektiv betjening af takeaway- og online bestillingsplatforme.

• 
Menuudvikling (Bonus): Vi ønsker aktivt at videreudvikle vores menu. Selvom det ikke er et krav, er interesse for opskriftsudvikling og kreative input et stort plus!

Hvem er du?

• 
Erfaring: Minimum 3 års professionel køkkenerfaring.

• 
Selvstændighed: Tryg ved at arbejde selvstændigt uden direkte supervision og med stærke beslutningsevner.

• 
Tempo og overblik: Meget velstruktureret og organiseret, og motiveres af at arbejde hurtigt og slå uret under travle perioder.

• 
Fysisk form: Kan trives med at arbejde fulde vagter på benene.

• 
Tilgængelighed: Klar og parat til at arbejde aften- og weekendvagter.

• 
Kommunikation: Gode engelskkundskaber (dansk er en kærkommen bonus).

• 
Passion: En ægte kærlighed til fried chicken og comfort food i høj kvalitet.

Vi tilbyder:

• 
Timeløn mellem 165 og 185 kr./time baseret på erfaring.

• 
En afslappet, lokalt forankret stemning på Gamma Bar i det kreative Nordvest.

• 
Mulighed for at præge de daglige arbejdsgange og få indflydelse på fremtidige menu-tiltag i takt med, at konceptet udvider sig.

Sådan ansøger du

Send dit CV samt en kort motiveret ansøgning om, hvorfor du er det rette match for Rays Chicken til:

• 
E-mail: work@diamondslice.dk

• 
Emnefelt: Rays Chefs

Vi gennemgår ansøgninger løbende. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!------------------

English Version

Location: Gamma Bar, Nordvest, Copenhagen

Employment Type: Part-time / Full-time (Evenings & Weekends)

Pay: 165 – 185 DKK / hour (based on experience)

Start Date: As soon as possible

About Rays Chicken

At Rays Chicken, we take fried chicken seriously. We make extra-crispy, buttermilk-brined fried chicken seasoned with our proprietary secret spice mix, serving the vibrant, packed crowd at the popular neighborhood spot Gamma Bar in Copenhagen Nordvest.

We are currently laying the groundwork for exciting future growth, and we are looking for a dedicated chef who wants to be an integral part of that journey.

The Role

We are seeking an experienced and dependable kitchen professional who can take charge of daily kitchen operations, maintain high standards of quality, and keep a cool head during busy periods.

On slower early-week shifts, you will have full autonomy to prep and run the kitchen independently. On busier nights, you will lead the service and direct kitchen support staff.

Key Responsibilities:

• 
Food Prep & Service: Daily mise en place, cooking, frying, plating, and ensuring high food quality.

• 
Independent Shifts: Running kitchen operations solo during early-week shifts.

• 
Team Leadership: Scheduling, guiding, and overseeing kitchen helpers and dishwashers.

• 
Stock & Orders: Managing inventory, placing orders, receiving deliveries, and liaising with daily suppliers.

• 
Hygiene & Safety: Keeping kitchen systems organized and strictly upholding Danish food safety and sanitation standards.

• 
Digital Orders: Operating takeaway and online delivery platforms efficiently.

• 
Menu Input (Bonus): We are actively looking to develop our menu. While not a strict requirement, an interest in recipe testing and creative input is a big plus!

What We Are Looking For:

• 
Experience: Minimum 3 years of professional kitchen experience.

• 
Independence: Confident working solo without direct supervision, with strong decision-making skills.

• 
Pace & Mindset: Highly structured, organized, and genuinely energized by working fast and beating the clock during rush hours.

• 
Stamina: Comfortable working full shifts on your feet.

• 
Availability: Ready and available to work evenings and weekends.

• 
Communication: Strong communication skills in English (Danish is an appreciated bonus).

• 
Passion: A true love for fried chicken and high-quality comfort food.

What We Offer:

• 
Hourly wage between 165 and 185 DKK/hour, commensurate with experience.

• 
A relaxed, community-driven atmosphere at Gamma Bar in creative Nordvest.

• 
Opportunity to shape operational routines and influence future menu offerings as the concept expands.

How to Apply

Send your CV and a brief cover letter telling us why you’d be a great fit for Rays Chicken to:

• 
Email: work@diamondslice.dk

• 
Subject line: Rays Chefs

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. We look forward to hearing from you!
